description.text: The promos of Japan's MEGA Series, with an M-P suffix and PROMO in place of an expansion code, released since 1 August 2025, when 001/M-P Chikorita came in the first MEGA Series Pokémon Card Gym Promo Card Pack. They come in Pokémon Card Gym and Extra Battle Day packs, at Friend Battle Together, Scramble Battle and Championship Series events, in Endorsed Independent Event Trainers Packs, from McDonald's Japan and in the 30th Celebration card sets. Matching M-P promos also come out in Traditional Chinese, Thai, Indonesian and Korean. The set is still growing.

description.text: One of six cards McDonald's gave with its Pokémon Happy Sets in Japan from 9 to 11 August 2025. Each meal came with a sealed pair: a Pikachu drawn for the campaign, and one of five others at random, this Sprigatito or Fuecoco, Quaxly, Ralts or Riolu. It prints McDonald's logo over the corner of the picture. Customers were asked to buy no more than five meals each, but on the first day McDonald's said many restaurants had already run out, and it later apologised for the crowds and reselling that followed.

The Mega Evolution-era print of Victory Symbol, the trophy card of Japan's Champions League, which had been awarded since 2023. It was never sold or given to entrants: only the top finishers of each league received one, in a print for their place. This 3rd Place print went to the players who finished third and fourth in each league at the 2026 season's tournaments, in Yokohama, Fukuoka, Aichi (twice) and Osaka, and continues into the 2027 season; small text on the Champions League logo names the placing and the city of each copy.
